title: Sign-in config: system actions to generate WEB_SESSION_PEPPER on the VM and to issue the passkey enrolment code; set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID + ALLOWED_EMAIL
note: [2026-10-12T07:58Z manager session_01G16FfyYSmDPQuuW55BuTmK] Operator is creating the Google OAuth Web client now (FinTrack AI project rejected as wrong account; re-doing).
